suggestions.title: Add a concise answer section
suggestions.description: Answer the main visitor question directly below the page heading.
suggestions.rationale: A direct answer makes the page easier for visitors and answer engines to understand.

suggestions.title: Publish a beginner planting guide
suggestions.description: Create a practical guide organized around seasonal planting questions.
suggestions.rationale: The guide addresses a relevant topic that is not covered by the current homepage.

suggestions.title: Test a community garden workshop ad group
suggestions.description: Group workshop-related keywords around a matching workshop landing page.
suggestions.rationale: Focused keywords and a matching destination can make a small test budget more useful.
suggestions.ad_group_guidance: Keep workshop-intent keywords in one tightly themed group.
suggestions.landing_page_fit: Use the workshops page and repeat the workshop details in the page heading.
suggestions.targeting_notes: Start with the local service area only.
